newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: United Chemical says acquisition approved.
newsitem.headline: United Chemical says acquisition approved.

text.p: Malaysia's United Chemical Industries Bhd said on Wednesday that its acquisition of Hongkew Holdings(M)Sdn Bhd has been approved by the Ministry of International Trade and Industries.
The company had announced in September it was acquiring a 100 percent interest in Hongkew Holdings from Sungei Wang Properties Sdn Bhd for 450 million ringgit.

It also said that initial payments totalling 50 million ringgit for the purchase consideration would be financed from bank borrowings and possibly through a private placement of United Chemical shares. The funding of the balance sum of 400 million ringgit would be structured at a later stage.
The acquisition would allow the plastic products firm to diversify into cement manufacturing and port operations in north-eastern Kelantan state.
Shares of United Chemical were suspended at midday on Wednesday pending an announcement. The Second Board stock was last traded at 18.20 ringgit, up 30 cents.
